fusions.name: Settling Accounts
fusions.desc: A quick cut that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, with 60% more damage for each, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sleeve Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks 2 darts in a narrow fan, each dealing 4 damage. You have 30% more critical chance against unwounded enemies.

fusions.name: Edge in Reserve
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds. Hidden stingers fight beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiet Opening
fusions.desc: When 8 seconds pass without a critical hit, your next strike has 50% more critical chance and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
